_note: DATA. Rules that fire on the TEXT of a recognized document's HEADER (facility, orderer, method, equipment) — NOT on a patient-declared condition_slot. A match makes affected analytes conditions_unknown (never violated) and opens a BLOCKING question. Patterns are normalized (NFC + lowercase + collapsed whitespace) substrings. Every entry states affects_independence, a disposition, and a source. Do NOT invent citations; a field-observed pattern is source.kind='field-case'.
